content.name: Flame Strike
entries: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 4d6} fire damage and {@damage 4d6} radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the fire damage or the radiant damage (your choice) increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|5-9|1d6} for each slot level above 5th.

content.name: Flame Strike
entries: A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cylinder} centered on a point within range makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d6} Fire damage and {@damage 5d6} Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Fire damage and the Radiant damage increase by {@scaledamage 5d6|5-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.
